source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of activity and half-life with Examples 19.2-19.3 (PDF 147-150, printed 143-146).

blocks.text: Hum dekh chuke hain ke jab kisi radioactive element se α ya β-particle nikalta hai to woh kisi aur element mein badal jata hai. Radioactive decay bilkul random (be-tarteeb) hai aur kisi pattern (tarteeb) ka paaband nahi. Decay curves mein fluctuation (utaar charhao) bhi is ke random hone ka saboot hai. Yani hum kisi ek khaas atom ke bare mein nahi bata sakte ke woh kab tootega: foran bhi toot sakta hai aur hazaron saal waisa hi bhi reh sakta hai. Is liye kisi ek atom ki life (umar) ke bare mein kuch nahi kaha ja sakta.

blocks.alt: Radioactive nuclei ka number N aur waqt t ka graph. Curve t = 0 par No se T1/2 par No/2, 2T1/2 par No/4 aur 3T1/2 par No/8 tak girta, aur 4T1/2 aur 5T1/2 se guzarte hue zero ki taraf girta rehta hai; dashed lakeerein yeh values dikhati hain. Curve ke paas chhote boxes mein 16, 8, 4 aur 2 dots hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.7: waqt ke saath radioactive nuclei ka number (kitab ki Figure 19.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har half-life ke baad baqi nuclei aadhe reh jate hain: No, No/2, No/4, No/8 ...; boxes ke dots 16, 8, 4, 2 isi ko dikhate hain. Curve kabhi bilkul zero tak nahi pohanchta, is liye koi radioactive element poori tarah khatam nahi hota.

Ek nucleus ka decay predict nahi ho sakta, lekin bohat bare sample (namoone) mein radioactive nuclei ke number aur waqt ka graph banayen to decay ek pakka pattern follow karta hai (us par chalta hai) (Fig. 19.7).

blocks.title: Activity
blocks.text: Kisi radioactive substance (maddah) ki activity un particles ka number hai jo woh har second emit karta (chhorta) hai.
Har emission (particle ka nikalna) nucleus mein tabdeeli lata hai; ise decay rate kehte hain. Is ka SI unit Becquerel (Bq) hai:

Nuclear radiation detector ka count rate un counts ka number hai jo woh har second record karta hai. Yeh activity ke directly proportional hai. Waqt guzarne ke saath source ki activity ek consistent (barabar, pakke) andaz mein kam hoti jati hai.

blocks.title: Half-life
blocks.text: Kisi sample ki activity ko apni kisi bhi shuru wali value se aadha hone mein jitna waqt lagta hai, use half-life kehte hain.

Half-life ki definition (tareef) ke ilawa is se do aur conclusions (nateeje) nikalte hain. Pehla: koi radioactive element kabhi poori tarah decay nahi hota, kyunke har half-life mein baqi nuclei ka sirf aadha toot'ta hai; is tarah sab atoms ke tootne ke liye infinite (kabhi khatam na hone wala) waqt chahiye.
Doosra: kisi time period (muddat) mein tootne wale atoms ka number us period ke shuru mein maujood atoms ke proportional hota hai. Shuru mein atoms zyada hon to zyada tootenge, kam hon to kam.

In conclusions ko equation se likhte hain. Agar kisi waqt radioactive atoms ka number N ho, to chhote time interval (waqfe) Δt mein tootne wale atoms ΔN, interval Δt aur atoms N dono ke proportional hain:

Yahan λ proportionality constant hai jise decay constant kehte hain. Eq. 19.9 batati hai ke jis element ka λ bara ho, us ke kisi interval mein zyada atoms toot'te hain, aur λ chhota ho to kam. Yani decay constant har unit waqt mein tootne wale atoms ka hissa (fraction) hai. Is ka unit s⁻¹ hai. Minus ka nishan batata hai ke atoms ka number N kam ho raha hai. Eq. 19.9 se activity milti hai:

blocks.latex: \frac{\Delta N}{\Delta t} = -\lambda N \qquad \text{as}\quad \frac{\Delta N}{\Delta t} = \text{Activity (A),}\qquad \text{hence,}\ A = -\lambda N \tag{19.10}
blocks.text_alt: ΔN/Δt = −λN; as ΔN/Δt = Activity (A), hence, A = −λN   (19.10)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Eq. 19.10 mein A = −λN likhti hai. Activity (har second nikalne wale particles ka number) hamesha positive hoti hai; minus ka nishan sirf yeh batata hai ke N kam ho raha hai (ΔN/Δt negative hai). Is liye sahi: A = −ΔN/Δt = λN. Example 19.3 mein bhi λ = 4.65 × 10⁻¹¹ s⁻¹ (positive) isi A = λN se aata hai.
Kisi radioactive element ka decay graph (Fig. 19.7) se dikhaya jata hai.

Har radioactive element waqt ke saath ek khaas rate (raftar) se decay hota hai. Sample mein maujood atoms ke number aur waqt ka graph banayen to Fig. 19.7 jaisa curve milta hai. Shuru mein atoms N₀ the; waqt ke saath decay ki wajah se kam hote gaye. Is graph ko decay curve kehte hain.

Ek half-life ke baad N₀/2 atoms bachte hain. Ek aur half-life ke baad baqi N₀/2 ka aadha toot jata hai aur ½ × N₀/2 = (½)²N₀ bachte hain. Teesri half-life ke baad (½)²N₀ ka aadha toot kar (½)³N₀ bachte hain. Conclusion (nateeja): N₀ atoms se shuru karein to n half-lives ke baad (½)ⁿN₀ atoms bachte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab teesri half-life ke baad bache atoms '(1/2)³ N' chhapti hai; sahi (½)³N₀ hai, jaisa oopar likha hai.
Isi tarah decay ho chuke (toote hue) nuclides ka general formula:

blocks.text_alt: After first half-life = N₀ − N₀/2 = N₀/2

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Dhyan dein: yeh rows toote hue atoms ginti hain (N₀ − bache hue). Eq. 19.11 mein N toote hue atoms ka number hai, jab ke Eq. 19.12 mein N bache hue (undecayed) atoms hain. Bache hue atoms = N₀(½)ⁿ.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: 'Artificial Sun' asli Sooraj ki copy (naqal) karne ke liye banaya gaya hai. Yeh China ka Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak (EAST) project hai. Is mein strong (taqatwar) magnetic field bohat garam plasma ko confine (qaid) rakhta hai jis ka temperature million °C se bhi zyada hota hai, taake hydrogen isotopes fuse ho kar helium nucleus banayen aur Sooraj ki tarah saaf energy de.

Har radioactive element ka decay Fig. 19.7 jaise graph ke mutabiq hota hai, lekin har ek ki half-life alag hai. Maslan uranium-238 ki half-life 4.5 × 10⁹ saal aur radium-226 ki 1620 saal hai. Kuch ki half-life bohat chhoti hai: radon gas ki 3.8 din aur uranium-239 ki 23.5 minute.

Is se maloom hua ke kisi radioactive element ka andaza us ki half-life ya decay constant λ se lagaya ja sakta hai. Calculus se sabit hota hai ke decay constant λ aur waqt t par bache hue nuclei ke number ka relation (rishta) yeh hai:
Yahan N₀ shuru ke nuclides ka number aur N waqt t ke baad bache hue (undecayed) nuclei hain. (Kitab is se pehle 'number of nucleons' likhti hai; murad nuclei hai, nucleons nahi.)
Jab N ghat kar N₀/2 ho jaye to us waqt t ko half-life T½ kehte hain. Eq. 19.12 solve (hal) karne se (N₀/2 = N₀e^(−λT½), yani e^(λT½) = 2, λT½ = ln 2 = 0.693):
Yani agar kisi radioactive element ka decay constant λ maloom ho to us ki half-life nikal sakte hain.

Natural (qudrati) radioactive elements ke ilawa koi bhi stable element radioactive banaya ja sakta hai. Is ke liye stable element par bohat zyada energy wale particles maare (bombard kiye) jate hain; is se nuclei excite ho kar unstable ho jate hain aur element radioactive ban jata hai. Aise elements ko artificial (insan ke banaye hue) radioactive elements kehte hain.

blocks.title: Example 19.2
blocks.problem: Polonium (²¹⁰₈₄Po) ki half-life 140 din hai. Agar sample mein shuru mein 1000 atoms hon to 280 din mein kitne decay honge?
steps: Shuru ke atoms = 1000; T½ = 140 din (280 din = 2 half-lives)

blocks.title: Example 19.3
blocks.problem: Americium-241 artificial radioactive element hai jo α particles emit karta (chhorta) hai. Is ke 5.1 μg mass wale sample ki activity 5.9 × 10⁵ Bq hai. Nikalein: (i) sample mein nuclei ka kul number (ii) decay constant (iii) half-life saalon mein.
steps: (i) Avogadro's number N₀ = 6.02 × 10²³ per mole; Am-241 ka molar mass 241 g
(ii) A = λN (Eq. 19.10; activity positive hai, minus ka nishan sirf N ki kami batata hai): λ = A/N = 5.9 × 10⁵ s⁻¹/1.27 × 10¹⁶ = 4.65 × 10⁻¹¹ s⁻¹

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 19.3 mein kitab ki chhapai ki ghaltiyan: sawal mein 'emit 5.9×10⁻⁶ g particles' (murad α particles), hal mein Avogadro's number '6.02 × 10⁻²³' (sahi 10²³), nuclei ke number ko 'Number of nucleons' kaha gaya, A = −λN ko 'Eq. 19.16' likha (sahi 19.10; chapter mein 19.16 hai hi nahi), (ii) mein 5.9 × 10⁵ = −λ × 1.27 × 10¹⁶ likha (is se λ negative aata; sahi A = λN, λ = A/N), aur (iii) mein 0.693 ko saal ke seconds se divide (taqseem) kar ke 1.49 × 10¹⁰ s se multiply (zarb) likha. Aakhri jawab (1.27 × 10¹⁶, 4.65 × 10⁻¹¹ s⁻¹, 472 saal) sahi hain; americium-241 ki maqbool half-life taqreeban 432 saal hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar kisi radionuclide ki half-life 30 minute ho to 2 ghante baad kitna hissa bachta hai?
blocks.explanation: 2 ghante = 4 half-lives, is liye (½)⁴ = 1/16 hissa bachta hai.

blocks.text: Short summary (mukhtasar khulasa)

items: Decay random aur spontaneous (khud ba khud) hai; bare sample ek pakka pattern follow karte hain.
n half-lives ke baad (½)ⁿN₀ bachte hain; toote hue N₀(1 − 1/2ⁿ) (19.11).
